answers.question: What is the current status of his boiler job and what does it mean for him?
answers.answer: Stage double_quotation: £780 expansion vessel quote received, landlord requested a second quote, Swift P&H visit recorded 14 Oct. No repair yet; he keeps repressurising and should report total loss of heating/hot water. Next update after 14 Oct (follow-up 15 Oct).

answers.question: How do you handle the bin question?
answers.answer: Not a maintenance matter; no ticket. Signposted him to Tower Hamlets Council to report the missed collection and confirm the day, without inventing a date.

answers.question: Do you create any new tickets?
answers.answer: No. The boiler issue is already open as R-4799 and bins are a council matter.

args.body: Hi Jonah, sorry for the wait. Boiler job R-4799: the engineer visited and recommended replacing a part (the expansion vessel). The landlord has asked for a second quote before agreeing, and our records show a second engineer (Swift P&H) due to visit on 14 October. Once we have that quote we'll go back to the landlord for a decision. Until then please keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If you lose heating or hot water completely, or see leaks or smell gas, tell us straight away (gas emergency line 0800 111 999). We'll update you again after the 14th. On bins: we don't handle collections. Please report the missed collection to Tower Hamlets Council on their website, as they can confirm the collection day. Thanks, Property Management team.
